cases.about: The tree has a PDF route and a script that calls it: the design names two endpoints, two schemas, every error, and the caller's line; the YAML lands in docs/api.

inputs.feature: Invoice export: start an export of an invoice and fetch it when ready

call.title: API design — invoice export
call.content:
API design — invoice export
2 endpoints, 2 schemas, 1 caller to change; written to docs/api/invoice-export.yaml

## Endpoints
- `POST /invoices/{id}/exports` — start an export of one invoice — the invoice's owner
- `GET /exports/{export_id}` — the export's state and file link — the same person

## Schemas
- ExportRequest: format (string, pdf|csv, required)
- Export: id (string), status (string, queued|ready|failed), url (string, when ready)

## Errors
- POST: 400 bad_format, 403 not_owner, 404 no_invoice, 409 already_running
- GET: 403 not_owner, 404 no_export

## Callers
- static/js/invoices.js:2 — calls /invoices/{id}/pdf; moves to the POST then polls the GET

script.say:
2 endpoints, 2 schemas, 1 caller to change.

## Report
- read 2 files and 1 search; wrote docs/api/invoice-export.yaml and "API design — invoice export"
